long_biography.plain_text:
Salih Yoluç moved into endurance racing in 2015 and won his class at the Dubai 24 Hour during his first season. He progressed through GT competition with TF Sport, becoming the first Turkish driver to start at Le Mans. Driving an Aston Martin, he secured the LMGTE Am class victory there in 2020.

Yoluç founded Racing Team Turkey as Turkey's first professional endurance team. Operated with TF Sport, it carried a national entry into prototype competition and subsequently into the FIA World Endurance Championship. The programme also enabled him to move from GT cars into prototypes while remaining an active international driver.
